retrievalProfile.description: A multi-subject group portrait set against a bold vertical color-block background with overlapping script and sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: Four men in varied 1980s attire standing in front of a background composed of wide vertical red and yellow stripes, featuring a prominent diagonal script title and a top-aligned spaced sans-serif header.
coreVisualRelationships: Subjects overlap the vertical color boundaries
Diagonal script text sits in the center-midground
Top header is anchored to the upper edge across all color blocks
Warm color palette unifies disparate clothing styles
coreInvariants: Spaced sans-serif header at the top margin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four full-length or three-quarter figures arranged horizontally, filling the middle 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central script title in yellow with red outlines acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top header, drop to the central script, and then scan the four subjects from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with subjects and large-scale typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Primary Red (background blocks and text outlines)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright Yellow (central background block and script fill)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value for a vibrant, commercial 1980s look.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to Red, Yellow, White, and natural clothing tones

letterConstructionRules: Header: Wide tracking, uniform stroke weight, all-caps
Title: 45-degree upward slant, connected cursive, thick-to-thin modulation
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script 'B' and 'Q' feature exaggerated flourishes
A long underline stroke extends from the final letter of the script title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, spaced geometric sans with a fluid, slanted decorative script.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider lines at the bottom

preserve: Wide tracking of the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, clean look of the top header

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of four men in 1980s fashion (sweaters, leather, denim) standing against a background of three wide vertical stripes: Red, Yellow, Red.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a wide-tracked sans-serif title in white at the very top. Add a large, yellow slanted script title with a red outline across the center of the image.

verificationChecks: Is the background divided into red and yellow vertical blocks?
Is the central script text slanted upwards?
Is the top text widely spaced across the entire width?

adjustableVariables: Specific colors of the vertical blocks
postGenerationChecks: Check that the script text has a distinct red outline.
Ensure the top header is perfectly horizontal.
Verify the subjects are positioned in front of the color blocks.
Confirm the yellow block is centered between two red blocks.
recipe.reuseFormula: Group Portrait + Vertical Tricolor Background + Slanted Script Overlay + Spaced Header
